title: DepthWorld: 3D World Model for Robot Manipulation
why_read: A robotics world-model paper that adds real 3D depth supervision to video prediction models, addressing a known weakness in current approaches.
analysis: Current video-based 'world models' used for robot planning are trained only on RGB video and often produce frame sequences that look locally plausible but don't actually form a consistent 3D scene over time. This paper builds a calibrated 3D version of the DROID robot dataset using stereo depth and a joint optimization across episodes, then trains a diffusion-based model to predict both RGB and depth together. They report a measurable image quality improvement (+1.48 dB PSNR) from adding depth supervision, which is a concrete, testable result rather than just a qualitative claim. This is a solid applied contribution for people building robot simulators or planning systems based on learned world models.
